rationale: The prompt materially requires A footer block of three linked recommendations, each tied to a supplied linked article.. The anchored # Series Recap Writer scopes the source-visible material to "Writes a concise \"previously on\" or \"catch-up\" block that brings new readers up to speed on a running story — summarising key developments in chronological order and framing what is at stake as the story continues."; this is a meaningful neighbouring route, but it does not supply the stated requirement as an independently executable output.
